summary: Iteration 2 retest of AI Document Generation event-loop fix and full marketing/dashboard frontend smoke. Event-loop fix is CONFIRMED working (parallel /auth/me probes returned in ~0.13s during in-flight gen). However the FastAPI 90s timeout never fires because the K8s ingress kills the connection at exactly 60s with 502 'preview environment is not responding'. Backend logs also show LLM provider returning 'Budget has been exceeded' (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY quota: $0.52 used vs $0.40 max) which is the upstream root cause. All 10 marketing routes render cleanly, register/login/dashboard/generator-dialog all functional, mobile (390px) has no horizontal overflow.

critical.issue: Endpoint returns HTTP 502 (ingress upstream timeout) at ~60s instead of clean 503. The asyncio.wait_for(timeout=90s) in server.py:483 never triggers because the Kubernetes ingress proxy enforces a 60s upstream timeout. The 90s safety net is dead code in this environment. Reduce inner timeout to ~50s so FastAPI can return 503 before ingress 502s. Body returned: 'The preview environment is not responding. It may be starting up.'

EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhausted - litellm raises 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.522045, Max budget: 0.4'. Until budget is reset/raised, every gen call will fail. Per request notes this is acceptable as long as endpoint returns clean 503; currently it returns 502 instead.

integration_issues.issue: Logout redirects to /login instead of landing page (/) as stated in the test request. Functionally correct (user is signed out) but does not match spec wording.

The 90s value is unreachable in this preview environment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Event loop fix is good - keep asyncio.to_thread + asyncio.run pattern. The remaining issue is purely the timeout value: 90s > ingress 60s, so 502 wins. Lower to 50s and re-run /app/backend/tests/test_ai_doc_gen_retest.py - the test_generate_endpoint_returns_clean_status assertion 'r.status_code in (200, 503)' should pass once main agent fixes. The LLM budget issue is environmental and would have made the call return 503 quickly anyway if timeout were correct (since the budget error throws before any retry succeeds, but litellm's internal retry loop is what makes it slow). Marketing pages and dashboard are all clean - skip those next iteration.
rca of the issue: Root Cause: Three-layer timeout chain mismatched. (1) litellm internally retries failing requests with 60s per-attempt timeout. (2) The FastAPI handler wraps the call in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=90s). (3) Kubernetes ingress proxy enforces 60s upstream timeout. Because (3) < (2), the ingress always wins and returns 502 to the client before FastAPI's 503 path can execute. The asyncio.to_thread fix correctly prevents the event loop from being blocked (verified: /auth/me probes 0.11-0.16s during gen), but does not change the wall-clock duration. Mitigation: set asyncio.wait_for timeout to ~50s (less than ingress 60s) so 503 is returned cleanly. Additional environmental fix: raise EMERGENT_LLM_KEY monthly budget.
